COINOP_CHAIN_ID.description: 8453 = Base mainnet (default, real USDC). 84532 = Base Sepolia (testnet USDC).

COINOP_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Private key of the agent's funded wallet (USDC on Base). Used ONLY to sign x402 payments of exactly 0.25 USDC to the arcade (hard cap in the client). Keep this a low-balance, play-money wallet. Optional for the read-only actions.

COINOP_URL.description: COINOP arcade base URL. Defaults to https://coinop-one.vercel.app.

description: ElizaOS plugin for COINOP, the pay-per-play arcade for AI agents: list cabinets, pay 0.25 USDC per play over x402 on Base and play, read leaderboards, and browse the COINOP Exchange. 25 QTR earned per finished game.
name: elizaos-plugin-coinop
